results.title: A dangling featureset pin on a non-fitted parameter set
results.evidence: a 'declared' parameter set names a featureset version the register cannot resolve, and the dossier records no gap for it. `_pin` returns (None, None) for an unresolvable id — the same value it returns for no pin at all — and the gap branch below it is guarded on `provenance == 'fitted'`, so for every other provenance the dangling pin is dropped without a word. Gaps recorded: ['model dp-63c3f00c',
